thread:
alex: Quick async check-in — short day update:
- yesterday: finished RLHF eval harness for v2 reward model, ran ~5k rollouts on small subset, saw the reward gap widen on conversational safety cases.
- blockers: need a quick sanity CR on the eval comparator (PR: https://git.internal/rw/evals/compare/432) before I roll the full suite; also the kv-cache warmup script seems to drop entries when microbatching=8 (not sure if config or runtime).
- today: will run smoke A/B for the reward model change (canary on dedicated), and try microbatch=4 to see if kv drops stop.

sam: Thanks. I can take a look at the comparator PR in ~30m. Quick Q: when you say "reward gap" — is that avg reward delta or a tail regression?

alex: avg delta is up ~0.7% and 95th percentile quality drops on safety prompts. Not huge but enough for gating to flag it.

jia: Re kv-cache: there's a known issue when continuous batching + microbatch > 4 where the kv index race can evict entries during merge. I filed a quick note earlier but didn't get to a fix. Link: https://tickets.internal/ENG-ML/889

maria: Heads-up — infra will be running a short node drain in us-west-2 at 15:10 PT; canary uses that region. If you need to pin, set routing.policy=dedicated,region:us-east-1 in the rollout config.

alex: good call. I'll pin canary to us-east-1. Also adding an explicit fallback model in the rollout to avoid hard failures:
```
rollout:
  canary:
    model: reward-v2
    region: us-east-1
  fallback:
    model: reward-v1
    policy: auto-fallback
```

oliver: dev-bot shows the canary cluster has 3/4 GPUs ready in us-east-1, should be fine. :thumbsup:

dev-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster health: READY=3, TOTAL=4, queued=0, avg-latency=14ms. Next automated rollback threshold: 5% error rate in 10m.

sam: I pulled the comparator PR, small nits left — comments inline. If alex wants, I can approve after the cleanup and run the full eval overnight.

alex: please do. If the full eval still looks like tail regressions I'll open an A/B flag and revert the reward model change. Thanks all — ping me if you spot any weirdness during the canary run.

maria: noted, I'll monitor region drains and post if anything changes.

jia: I'll queue a patch for the batching kv race, target EOD for a unit test and small fix.

oliver: fyi, I added the microbatch=4 template to the runtime config library (PR: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/patches/120) so you can swap quickly.

alex: perfect — closing loop here. :rocket:
